limitations: Bulk1M GSP not duplicated locally; remote runtime hashes bind it and candidate row extraction provides derived bytes for local direct-score replay, not a standalone membership proof.
The pinned native code has the disclosed stride cast compatibility repair. No unmodified-release,canonical-primary-U64,held-out,original-model float or service-tail performance claim.
Shared-node/clock sampling is observational; absence of multiple sampled PIDs does not establish exclusivity.
